about: sha256 goldens of assetgen's street stage (AG7): the small test city's packs (tests/conftest.py SMALL, built by the citygen CLI) and Vesper Bay's, as `assetgen.streets.build.outputs_digest` measures them (every tile pack, the parts pack and the Unreal contribution; `all` hashes them together), with the tiles of Vesper Bay that hold the most triangles, the contribution with AG6's textures (the 512 px/m library). Made on the M4 Mac; x86 deferred (docs/determinism_check.md). M19: made again on the Windows PC (its build of the M15 goldens matched them byte for byte): the street stage's code changed (AG7 draws M19's cap beams) and Vesper Bay's model moved.
